messages:
elaine.k: Quick sync — before launch next week we need to prune triggered newsletter flows and test a daily vs weekly digest for new signups. Current flows: welcome, product-updates, benchmarks, webinar-invite. Thoughts on segmenting by intent (benchmarks vs infra)?

mike_g: +1. Suggest we route 'benchmark' intent to weekly digest, dev/infra intent to a short daily digest with product updates. Also recommend gating by engagement_score > 1 for daily so we don't spam.

sam_pm: I can map the current segments and push the targeting rules. We currently have fields: signup_source, first_use, engagement_count, intent_tag. Quick SQL to pull recent signups with intent: 

```sql
SELECT id, email, intent_tag, signup_source, created_at
FROM users
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '14 days'
  AND intent_tag IS NOT NULL;
```

sam_pm: For A/B we should ensure the routing key (intent_tag) is preserved through the mailer webhook.

nina_ops: Heads up — current mailer mapping drops custom headers from partner-onboarding flows. I'll open a ticket (TKT-4123) to update webhook transformation. Ops will need a small patch to preserve X-Intent-Tag.

mike_g: A/B plan idea: Variant A = daily short digest (5 lines, focus = quick wins). Variant B = weekly long digest (3 sections: benchmarks, launches, how-tos). Metrics: open rate, click-through rate, 7-day activation, unsubscribe. Split 50/50 for the first 10k new signups, then ramp.

elaine.k: Schedule idea: start tests Monday 9am PT. Can we QA templates in staging on Friday?

sam_pm: Yes — I'll set up a preview list of 50 test users and wire up the campaign preview. Also adding UTM params for tracking. Example href we will use in templates: 

```text
https://redwood.ai/blog/benchmark-suite?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_digest_v1&utm_content=weekly_vs_daily
```

nina_ops: TKT-4123 created. Patch landed on a branch, needs a staging deploy. @deploybot can you queue staging/email-service?

deploybot: deploy queued: staging/email-service v2.3.4 -> starting build (triggered by nina_ops)

deploybot: deploy succeeded: staging/email-service v2.3.4 (duration 2m 18s)

mike_g: Make sure analytics events include context: {"digest_variant":"A|B", "intent_tag":"..."} so we can slice 7d activation by variant+intent. Events we need: email.sent, email.open, email.click, user.activated.

sam_pm: Adding those to the campaign spec and to the eval dashboard. I'll create a small prompt-set for subject-line quality checks and share results.

elaine.k: Action items: 1) sam — create staging preview + add UTM and campaign spec, 2) nina — confirm webhook patch deployed + link TKT-4123, 3) mike — configure A/B split in campaign manager and wire analytics, 4) me — finalize copy & creative and update launch checklist.

mike_g: :thumbsup:

sam_pm: I'll post the preview links here when ready.

nina_ops: Confirmed — webhook patch live on staging and TKT-4123 updated with PR link.

elaine.k: Perfect. If we see higher unsub rates in daily, we cut it and promote weekly. Will reconvene after first 72h of sends. :sparkles:
